lines: Ah, cheers to this wonderful world once again.
The laughter that flies through the city.
It’s just a fabricated thing we pretend not to see.
I feel like I’m going insane.
A scent so strong it makes my head spin,
piercing the back of my nose.
I awaken exactly as my instinct dictates.
Whose turn is it today?
What can one do in this world?
What can I do?
So that those pitch‑black eyes of mine
won’t overflow with tears.
I wish, again and again, for the future I dream of,
to devour it.
In this world full of mistakes,
I want you to smile.
I won’t hurt anyone any more.
I want to become stronger, stronger.
So that I can remain myself.
This wonderful world is safe today as well.
The bad rumors swirling through the city.
We turned away, pretending not to know.
This isn’t sanity at all.
A parade dressed up seriously,
its marching steps bounce toward a destination.
A lingering taste that never fades clings inside.
The world behind the scenes.
Living purely and rightly,
living without making anyone sad,
living straight without straying,
is that living without mistake?
Is living just as we are the justice?
Is deceiving and surviving the justice?
What is the shape I ought to have?
Who am I really?
Tell me.
Tell me.
Today as well,
in a world without answers,
I’m wishing.
Though clumsy,
forever with you, simply,
because I want to keep laughing with you.
Ah, my heart leaps,
shaking my body, I scream.
Now is the time to move.
Ah, I’ll keep devouring my weak self over and over.
to consume it completely.
In this world full of mistakes,
I want you to smile.
So that no one cries any more.
I want to become stronger, stronger.
So that I can remain myself.
Just to protect you.
Run, run, run.
To surpass the me inside me.
